activity: Plot-only aggregation of retained reports; zero patient/generated-row reads, fits or scientific evaluations.
source_pointers: Every seed, mean/range and reference in AGGREGATE_SOURCE.json records its originating JSON pointer.

figure1_main_scientific_utility.reference_uncertainty: CHNS CR1-t 95% interval; ENSANUT equal-cell empirical stability band.

figure2_chns_information_conditions.reference_uncertainty: CHNS CR1-t 95% intervals for regressions; none for correlations.

limitations.main: External-literature E0/E1 development comparison, all six primary endpoints.
limitations.historical: Separate historical L/R development experiment; R receives all 30 target summaries, including plotted effects and correlations. Final stages only.
limitations.uncertainty: Seed ranges are not CIs. CHNS reference shading is a community-cluster CR1-t 95% interval; ENSANUT shading is an empirical cluster-resampling stability band for its equal-cell standard.
limitations.no_pooling: No inferential pooling, cross-protocol causal contrasts or selection of best authors.
limitations.custom_statistical_supplement: Not plotted here; retained in its separate published supplementary results.
